note: 99 Articles, no Annexes — verified against the EUR-Lex consolidated DOM on 2026-08-15. The only consolidation is 2016-05-04, which folds in the 2018 corrigendum; the GDPR has not been amended since. The data-protection Digital Omnibus (COM(2025) 837) would amend this text but was still a Council proposal at retrieval and is NOT reflected here. EUR-Lex consolidated texts omit the preamble, so this corpus contains no recitals — a significant limitation for the GDPR specifically, whose 173 recitals are routinely cited as interpretive authority. Consolidation markers, footnotes and markdown link syntax are stripped at fetch time; NBSP and soft hyphens are folded by src/lib/rulepack/normalise.ts at hash and match time. Text is reused from EUR-Lex under CC BY 4.0 (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU).
